Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir‑faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free‑minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury. Our Brand With over 115 Sofitel and Sofitel Legend hotels in more than 45 countries, our reach is truly global, making the sky the limit for growth opportunities. As our portfolio expands each year, there are ample opportunities to be involved in both our existing properties and our future openings. Our Hotel As a landmark for Sofitel in the Americas, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema re‑emerges as a revitalized beachfront icon where French elegance meets the vibrant Carioca lifestyle. Designed as a sanctuary of art, craftsmanship, and sensory experiences, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in Rio de Janeiro. The property features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy elevated dining on the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in. The design vision is led by Brazilian architect Patricia Anastassiadis, whose storytelling approach blends heritage, artistry, and contemporary sophistication, creating spaces that feel both meaningful and deeply connected to place. Set beneath the iconic Christ the Redeemer, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema stands as the ultimate destination for discerning travelers—where luxury meets the true soul of Rio. Position As our E-Commerce & Marketing Manager , you are the hotel’s digital and brand positioning architect. This role elevates the hotel’s visibility across all digital touchpoints, drives direct revenue growth, and safeguards brand integrity in alignment with Sofitel standards. As a key member of the Commercial Leadership Team, this role reports to the General Manager and combines strategic vision with analytical rigor, ensuring the hotel is positioned as a preferred destination for discerning travelers, meetings, and social events. What You Will Do Digital Strategy & Direct Revenue Growth Develop and execute a comprehensive e‑commerce strategy to maximize direct bookings and optimize digital conversion Drive performance across brand.com, OTA channels, luxury consortia platforms, and paid media Oversee website content, digital platforms optimization, booking engine performance, and SEO/SEM initiatives Manage digital align digital strategy with pricing and demand periods Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales, Revenue, and Operations to support need periods, group campaigns, and F&B initiatives Support hotel’s pre‑opening positioning strategies Act as the hotel’s digital champion, driving innovation and best practices Qualifications What You Will Bring 5+ years in luxury hospitality marketing, e‑commerce, or digital commerce Proven track record driving direct revenue, digital campaigns, and brand.com performance Experience with booking engines, OTAs, digital distribution, loyalty programs, title: Senior Network Engineer
description: When defining the purpose of a job it is helpful to consider questions like: In what way does it contribute to the value of company? What part of the organisation’s or team’s total purpose is accomplished by people in this job? What is the unique contribution of this job that distinguishes it from other jobs? PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES’s Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES’s growing network and datacenter presence around the world. You will lead and assist with various projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, security, VoIP, and multi-media services including inflight entertainment. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance. Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc. Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity. Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software. Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices. Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation. Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information. Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices. Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 5-7 years’ hands‑on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware. Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS‑XE, and NX‑OS, PAN‑OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command‑line interfaces. Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking. Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD‑WAN) Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi‑data center environments Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high‑throughput applications. Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus Hands‑on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis. In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access. Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192. Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus Racking various types of networks and server equipment. Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices. Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments. OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator) Embark on a career with us, where diversity isn't just a buzzword – it's our driving force. We are crafting a workplace mosaic that values every hue, background, and perspective. Join a global team where inclusivity sparks innovation, and individuality is not only embraced but celebrated. We take great pride in creating safe and inclusive processes and we support the recruitment, retention, and evolution of all employees irrespective of gender, colour, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, veteran or marital status, background or walk in life. SES and its Affiliated Companies are committed to providing fair and equal employment opportunities to all. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law. title: Fonoaudiólogo(a)

Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa. Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz. Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados. Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA. Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente. Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar.
